## Parent Task Context (Already Completed)

> **Note:** The following parent task has already been completed. This context is provided to help you understand the background and requirements for this sub-task. Do not re-implement the parent task - focus only on the new sub-task described below.

### Implement Git submodules for multi-repository consolidation

**Description:** Implement Git Submodules Architecture for Multi-Repository Project

Restructure the project to use a parent repository with Git submodules, consolidating multiple independent repositories into a single orchestrated project structure.

Requirements:
- Create a new parent repository that will serve as the project root
- Identify all existing repositories that should become submodules
- Add each repository as a Git submodule in appropriate directory structure
- Define clear naming conventions and directory hierarchy for submodules
- Document submodule initialization and update procedures for team members
- Create or update root-level README with project overview and submodule map
- Add initialization script to automate cloning and setup of all submodules
- Configure .gitmodules file with correct paths and remote URLs
- Establish branching strategy across parent and submodule repositories
- Update CI/CD pipelines to handle submodule updates if applicable

Considerations:
- Determine whether to track specific commits or branches in submodules
- Plan migration path for existing local development environments
- Verify all team members have appropriate access to all submodule repositories
- Consider alternative approaches (monorepo, Git subtrees) if submodules limitations are problematic
- Document common submodule operations (updating, pulling changes, pushing to submodules)

---

## Task Description

Add Git Submodules and Update Build Scripts

Configure git submodules for multiple framework-based todo applications and update the project's build/development scripts to work with the new submodule structure.

Requirements:
- Add the following repositories as git submodules in .gitmodules:
  - angular-todo
  - react-todo
  - vue-todo
  - svelte-todo
- Determine appropriate submodule paths within the project structure
- Initialize and update submodules after adding them
- Update package.json scripts to:
  - Install dependencies across all submodules
  - Run development servers for each framework variant
  - Build all variants together or individually
  - Clean/reset submodules
- Update any existing CI/CD configuration to handle submodule checkout
- Document submodule workflow in README (clone with --recursive, update commands)

Edge cases to consider:
- Ensure submodule URLs are accessible (verify repository paths exist)
- Handle cases where submodules may already exist locally
- Consider whether scripts should run sequentially or in parallel
